Theorem J-E'' is PROVED: demote fixed set S = {y in M : y in Iy} equals the stable image I^infinity M = e_I M (idempotent of I-full local factors); trichotomy: immune iff IM=M, demote-full iff I nilpotent on M, mixed otherwise (three cases mutually exclusive for k_P>0; M=0 vacuous). EXP-052 computes dim S on ALL 202 catalogue parents by the ideal-power chain F_{r+1}=I F_r in EXP-047 quotient coordinates (descent is automatic; containment is asserted each step as a regression tripwire; stabilization certified by rank equality): 192 demote_full / 10 immune / 0 mixed; chains <= 3 steps; I^2 M = 0 on every demoting parent; the six k_P>20 parents (phase2_90, 30_6_0007/0008/0012/0013/0039), unreachable by enumeration (2^24-2^60 classes), are ALL demote_full. Cross-validation: immune set == EXP-047 immunity_exact (10/10); integer counts 2^k_P - 2^s == classes_demote on all 196 EXP-050 records (2,693,100 classes), zero mismatches. Demote fraction in {0,1} is a catalogue-wide machine-exact corollary; universal no-mixed (problem J-A) remains OPEN. Caveat credited in review: primary (p^a,q^b) blocks are NOT generally local (GF(4)xGF(4) on 6x6), which is why the algebraization uses the F-chain and never needs the factor decomposition.

results.statement: Theorem J-G PROVED: the single-row demote law is an invariant of the ideal I = Ann_R(A,B) alone. dim S = 2 dim_GF(2) I^infty; for k_P>0: demote-full iff I nilpotent, immune iff I^2=I, mixed iff 0 != I^infty != I; M=0 iff I=0. Proof: componentwise splitting over local Artinian factors (I_beta = R_beta exactly where A_beta = B_beta = 0, where the localized H_X vanishes so M_beta = R_beta^2), I^infty = e_I R, plus J-E'' (S = e_I M); the immune direction uses that F_2[G] and each of its blocks is Frobenius, giving dim I_beta = dim R_beta/(A_beta,B_beta) = dim M_beta / 2, hence M_beta = 0 iff I_beta = 0. EXP-053 reproduces EXP-052's module-chain classification on ALL 202 catalogue parents from the ideal alone (k_P = 2 dim I and dim S = 2 dim I^infty on 202/202, identical cases 192 demote-full / 10 immune / 0 mixed, zero mismatches, 8.9 s for the whole catalogue). SHARPENED: nilpotency index is exactly 2 on all 192 demoting parents (I^2 = 0) and I^2 = I on all 10 immune ones -- the catalogue realizes only the two extremes. COROLLARY J-G1 (odd lattices): both ell,m odd => x^ell-1, y^m-1 squarefree => R semisimple => every ideal idempotent => no parent admits a single-row syzygy demotion; 3,600 weight-<=3 parents over nine odd lattices, zero violations. Of the seven published BB instances exactly one is protected this way: [[90,8,10]] on (ell,m)=(15,3) is IMMUNE, while [[72,12,6]], [[108,8,10]], Gross [[144,12,12]], [[288,12,18]], [[360,12,<=24]] and [[756,16,<=34]] all have I^2 = 0 (every nonzero class demotes). DUAL-IDEAL AUDIT (added after review flagged the Ann_R(A,B) vs Ann_R(M) confusion risk): the module annihilator is the RECIPROCAL ideal, Ann_R(M) = (bar a, bar b) -- H_X acts through transposed circulants, so M_beta = (R_beta/(bar a_beta, bar b_beta))^2 -- verified on 202/202 parents plus the mixed witness by two independent computations (the quotient action on M versus the ideal generated by the two H_Z blocks), together with the Frobenius identity dim I + dim Ann_R(M) = dim R = ell*m on 202/202. The bar is load-bearing: (a,b) itself is bar-invariant on only 156 of the 202 parents, so an audit comparing Ann_R(M) against (a,b) fails on the other 46 (the first version of this audit did exactly that and was caught by its own test). The two ideals are never interchangeable: substituting Ann_R(M) into dim S = 2 dim I^infty returns 2(ell*m - k_P/2) in {100,172,344} on the ten immune parents instead of dim S = k_P in {8,16}, a positive number instead of 0 on demoting parents, and misclassifies the mixed witness as demote-full. Retracted en route: an earlier framing claimed a three-way 'zero+unit+deficient = dim R' factor-partition identity; that is an algebraic tautology (dim Ann_R(M) = ell*m - dim I by Frobenius), not an independent check, and the prose asserting it was removed before the PDF rebuild. The surviving machine proxies for the factor partition are dim I^infty (zero part) and dim I - dim I^infty (nilpotent part on deficient factors): immune iff the latter is 0, demote-full iff the former is 0, with the witness the only instance having both nonzero (2 and 2).

results.statement: Theorems J-H/J-I/J-J PROVED, resolving open problem J-A. Local structure: G = Z_ell x Z_m = G_2 x G_odd, F_2[G_odd] = prod_chi F_chi semisimple, F_2[G_2] local with nilpotent maximal ideal, so the local factors of R are R_chi = F_chi[G_2] with G_2 an F_chi-basis. J-H (exact-vanishing coset law): partitioning supp(a) by 2-part, a_chi = sum_h (sum_{u in S_h} chi(u)) h, so a_chi = 0 iff every coset sum vanishes, a_chi is a non-unit iff the total sum vanishes, and exact vanishing forces |S_h| >= 2 on every occupied coset; hence a weight-<=3 polynomial that vanishes exactly somewhere occupies a single coset and is a scalar (zero-or-unit) at every factor. J-I (weight law): if wt(A) <= 3 and wt(B) <= 3 the parent is NEVER mixed, on any lattice -- mixed requires weight >= 4 spread over >= 2 cosets in one of A,B. This explains the catalogue's all-or-nothing demote law without enumeration (all 202 parents are weight-(3,3)). J-J (existence, threshold attained): on (ell,m) = (2,3), A = (1+x)(y+y^2), B = A*y give dim I = 4, dim I^2 = dim I^infty = 2 -- a MIXED parent with k_P = 8, dim S = 4 and exactly 2^8 - 2^4 = 240 of 255 nonzero classes demoting, verified three independent ways (ideal chain; EXP-052 module chain [8,4,4]; brute-force decision of all 255 classes by EXP-047's exact rank test). Machine confirmation of J-I: EXP-054 exhaustive census of 653,022,021 translation-normalised weight-<=3 pairs over 18 lattices -- every catalogue lattice (3,6),(6,3),(6,6),(9,6),(12,6),(15,6),(30,6), the previously underexplored (12,12),(15,12), and a parity grid -- finds ZERO mixed pairs, with 450 sampled pairs re-decided by the independent direct route (zero disagreements). Additional exact fingerprint: the single-G_2-coset predicate separates the catalogue exactly -- all 10 immune parents single-coset, all 192 demoting parents multi-coset, no exceptions (for m=6 this is y-exponent parity). Open residual: sharp weight/lattice map at weight >= 4, and whether any mixed parent has useful [[n,k,d]] (the witness is a [[12,8]] toy).

results.statement: EXP-055 ODD-LATTICE RESULT. Raw-I fallback retracted: it fails physical-kernel membership on (7,7)[[98,6,12]] (FR-026). The pole ceiling d<=min wt(J\0) is a short corollary of published structure; all 25 reproduced reported values pass as a sanity check, but Wang-Mueller values are BP-OSD upper bounds and Postema values are Monte-Carlo estimates. Five rows are locally two-sided exact (zero ceiling violations, slack 2/10/22); estimates never enter domination thresholds. [[30,8,4]] was not found as a BB constructor in the checked primary tables, but Grassl gives [[30,8,7]], so it is globally dominated and not a general-code/end-to-end Pareto result. FIXED-POINT SCREEN SCOPE: all nine odd lattices through n=126, exact weight-3 A/B, 8<=k<=24; 715 symmetry classes / 10,247 normalised pairs. All 598 classes with an independently exact reference are dominated (588 explicit logical witnesses, 10 all-sector CP-SAT); 117 high-k classes have no reference; zero survivors and zero undecided. Screen shards are census-hash/reference-hash/protocol bound. The algebraic census is complete to n=360; distance closure above n=126 remains open; [[162,8,14]] exactification did not finish in 2,100s.
